chapter: Jazz at the Philharmonic and life on the road
title: Working with Charlie Parker
summary: Dizzy's friends in the 1940s weren't yet on their own. Humes recorded with Charlie Parker and found him fine, playing blues and everything; after hearing the Basie boys he did not strike her as strange.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Well listen Helen, who would always come with Dizzy? What other guys?
Oh, I don't know.
Babs and . . .
Yeah, just whoever was working there.

Yeah. So I didn't have a thing to do with that.
